verdict.rationale: Zulip's channel docs refer to a guest role whose access is restricted: guests, unlike other users, cannot subscribe to any public channel. That implies guest accounts with limited access exist, but it is a single passing mention. Missing for 10: documentation of how admins create or invite guest accounts, which channels guests can see or join, shared or cross-organization channels for external partners, the full guest permission model, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access

citations.quote: Everyone other than guests can subscribe to any public or web-public channel.
